QuestInfo.name: A Story that Cannot be Told
QuestInfo.0: After you disappeared because of the Black Mage's curse, Freud traveled the world telling them of the heroes... except you. Did he feel guilty about you sacrificing yourself. You want to tell him that you're fine, but you feel despaired at the fact that you can't.
